mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.ip) as retention_count FROM access_user_detail a INNER JOIN access_user_detail b ON a.ip = b.ip WHERE a.visit_date = #{baseDate} AND b.visit_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(#{baseDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d')

SELECT location_country as country, location_province as province, location_city as city, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) as ipCount FROM access_user_detail WHERE visit_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY), '%Y%m%d') AND location_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY location_country, location_province, location_city ORDER BY ipCount DESC
SELECT id, ip FROM access_user_detail WHERE location_country IS NULL LIMIT #{limit}
